description: Port of ESLint's `max-depth` (https://eslint.org/docs/latest/rules/max-depth) with max 4 (the default): flags a block statement nested more than max levels inside its function, static block or program. Options are declared in the `options` define (the rule's defaults); a variant is a config patch.

cases.3: Blocks are nested too deeply. Maximum allowed is 3.
cases.2: Blocks are nested too deeply. Maximum allowed is 2.
cases.1: Blocks are nested too deeply. Maximum allowed is 1.

cases.3: Blocks are nested too deeply. Maximum allowed is 3.
cases.2: Blocks are nested too deeply. Maximum allowed is 2.
cases.0: Blocks are nested too deeply. Maximum allowed is 0.

default.default: Blocks are nested too deeply. Maximum allowed is 4.
